issue.description:
Split child 4 of 4 (final) under umbrella beadrs-c52cfaf5. Assembles the three sibling captures into the single baseline snapshot that downstream beadrs-7b1fa066 (verify zero working-tree mutations against the captured baseline) will diff against.

SIBLINGS
- beadrs-f6fa89e4 (porcelain v1 + line count)
- beadrs-162ecaa8 (porcelain v2 --branch)
- beadrs-e54b733c (HEAD SHA + subject + ahead/behind)

STEPS
1. Read the notes of the three sibling beads with bead show.
2. Verify all three carry capture timestamps and note any HEAD drift between them. HEAD may advance while other workers commit; drift is expected and must be recorded, not reconciled.
3. Append ONE consolidated SNAPSHOT block to umbrella beadrs-c52cfaf5 notes via bead update beadrs-c52cfaf5 --notes ... --if-revision N. Notes REPLACE: run bead show beadrs-c52cfaf5 first and preserve all existing note text, appending the new block after it. The consolidated block must contain: verbatim porcelain v1, line count, verbatim porcelain v2 --branch (or explained absence), HEAD SHA + subject, ahead/behind counts, capture timestamps, and the three sibling IDs.
4. Mutate nothing outside .beads/.

ACCEPTANCE
- beadrs-c52cfaf5 notes contain one consolidated baseline block with verbatim v1 + v2 + HEAD + timestamps + sibling IDs
- Existing parent note text preserved (replace-with-append, --if-revision guarded)
- No mutations outside .beads/
